reasoning: A freelance salary tracker involves managing multiple income streams and pending payments, which can be stressful. We avoid the typical 'fintech blue' or 'crypto dark mode' in favor of an Organic & Earthy palette. Warm tones and natural greens create a sense of steady growth, calm, and approachability.

typography.strategy: Outfit provides a modern, slightly geometric structure to numbers and dashboard metrics, while Manrope ensures absolute legibility for dense tables and logs. We employ tight tracking on large metric numbers to create a 'Pro' feel.

rules: Use 'border-collapse' style or crisp 1px borders (#EAE6DF) for dashboard widgets rather than heavy shadows.
Grid widgets must use h-full to stretch and align perfectly.
Use generosity in whitespace (p-8 on main containers) to prevent cognitive overload.

components.surface_strategy: Neumorphism/Tactile mix: Flat white backgrounds with a crisp 1px border. No shadows on resting state, but a subtle '-translate-y-[2px]' and 'shadow-sm' on hover for interactive cards.
components.buttons: Primary buttons use Deep Forest Green (#344E41) with white text. Secondary buttons use transparent backgrounds with 1px border and text_primary.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Ensure tooltips have a white background, 1px border, and no heavy drop shadow to match the organic flat theme.
components.tables: Left-aligned headers, numeric columns right-aligned. Use alternating row background colors (bg-[#FDFCFB]/50) for easier scanning.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements transition transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up (translate-y-2 to 0) for dashboard widgets on mount, staggered.

empty_state_bg.description: Clean minimalist workspace for empty states or login background

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Google Authentication (can be mocked with a 'Sign in with Google' button that sets a mock user session).
Build a Left Sidebar or Top Navigation layout for the Dashboard.
Dashboard must contain 4 summary metric cards (Earnings, Balance, Hours, Active Jobs).
Implement a Job Management section: Add, Edit, Delete jobs (Name, Hourly Rate).
Implement an Hours Logging form (Select Job, Date, Hours). Auto-calculate Pay = Hours * Job Rate.
Implement a Payments received section to log cash inflows. Balance = Total Pay - Total Payments Received.
Use Recharts to show Job-wise earnings breakdown (e.g., Bar chart).
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Use standard HTML structure but leverage Shadcn UI heavily for forms, dialogs, selects, and tables.
